A device restart interrupted your scan session. Tap to reopen NearScan and resume.
Your last scan session ended unexpectedly — likely a device restart or the system stopping the app to save battery. Resume where it left off, or dismiss to end it.

NearScan scans WiFi, Bluetooth (Classic + BLE), and cell towers in the background and logs each sighting with your current location. Tap START to begin a session — it keeps running with the screen off. Tap STOP to end it.

Set your location manually, or use the GPS button in the Set Location dialog for a quick rough fix. Every logged record uses whichever location was last set — update it whenever you move somewhere new.

Open the settings (gear) panel to enable or disable WiFi, Bluetooth, BLE, and Cell scanning independently and set how often each one runs. WiFi can also be filtered by minimum signal strength and by band (2.4/5/6 GHz).

Tap the share icon in the top bar to export your scan history (WiGLE CSV, custom CSV, GeoJSON, or SQLite) and send it by mail, messenger, or cloud storage from the share sheet. Turn on auto-export in settings to export on a fixed interval automatically.
For long or multi-day sessions, allow NearScan to ignore battery optimization when prompted — otherwise Android\'s Doze mode can pause scanning while the phone is stationary with the screen off.

NearScan can be fully controlled from Tasker (or MacroDroid/Automate) using standard Android broadcasts and a Content Provider — no plugin needed. Reference below; action and extra names are shown in English since they\'re literal values you enter into Tasker.
